tools.name: get_latest
tools.description: Current headline readings (value, unit, observation date) for the site's charts: S&P 500 level, Shiller CAPE, forward P/E for the S&P 500, Nasdaq 100, SOX and sector ETFs, VIX, drawdown from the high, breadth, Magnificent 7 weight and more. Pass `id` for one chart, or omit it for all.

id.description: Chart id, e.g. "pe" (Shiller CAPE), "forward-pe", "ndx-forward-pe", "drawdown", "vix". Omit for every reading.

tools.name: annual_returns
tools.description: Calendar-year returns by year with the arithmetic mean and compound annual rate over the complete years in the range. The basis depends on the index and is stated in `basis`: sp500 (from 1928) has both price return and total return (dividends reinvested); ndx and sox are index levels, price return only; xlk, xlf, xly and xlp are fund prices adjusted for dividends, total return only. A basis an index does not have is null. The current year is year-to-date and flagged `ytd`.

index.description: Which index or ETF. Default sp500.

tools.name: index_changes
tools.description: Constituent changes with effective date, the company added, the company removed and the reason. sp500 from 2016, ndx from 2020. Newest first.

since.description: Only changes effective on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

ticker.description: Only changes that add or remove this ticker.

tools.name: search_charts
tools.description: Search the site's charts by topic or question (e.g. "bear markets", "Shiller CAPE", "Nasdaq 100 drawdown", "monthly seasonality"). Returns each chart's title, the question it answers, its page and the dataset path to pass to get_dataset.

query.description: Words to match against chart titles and the questions they answer.

tools.name: get_dataset
tools.description: Read one published dataset (the JSON behind a chart), e.g. "sp500/drawdowns", "sp500/pe", "ndx/forward-pe", "recessions". Rows can be filtered by `since`/`until` on their `date` (or `year`). A result is capped at about 60,000 characters: when a file is larger (long daily series), each array keeps its most recent rows and the cut is reported under `windowed`. Scalars and summary fields are always included.

path.description: Dataset path without /api/ and .json, as returned by search_charts.

since.description: Keep rows dated on or after this (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY).

until.description: Keep rows dated on or before this (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY).

tail.description: Rows kept per array after filtering, from the end. By default every row is returned when the result fits; long daily series are cut to their most recent rows and reported under `windowed`.
